summary: 8 browser checks (one per UI-facing acceptance criterion) and 8 backend pytest files covering the API-bearing criteria. 18 of 19 check entries passed; 1 backend test documents a real bug (DM thread title is not personalized per viewer).

bugs.criterion: Messaging: DM and Space team chat, both send paths
bugs.title: DM conversation title is static (creator's perspective only) instead of personalized per viewer
bugs.description: POST /conversations for a direct thread stores a single `title` field set to the OTHER participant's name as seen by the CREATOR at creation time. Every subsequent viewer of that same conversation (including the recipient) is served that same stored title, so the recipient's Inbox shows THEIR OWN name as the thread title instead of the sender's name. The acceptance criterion requires 'New Message -> DM by email starts a thread titled with the other person's name' for both sides of the conversation.
bugs.evidence: backend test tests/test_tscheck_messaging_mentions.py::test_dm_send_receive_and_thread_isolation — httpx POST /api/conversations (kind=direct) as user A ('Msg Sender A') to user B ('Msg Recipient B') returns id X; GET /api/conversations as user B for the same id X returns title='Msg Recipient B' (B's own name) instead of 'Msg Sender A'. Raw assertion failure: "recipient should see the other person's name ('Msg Sender A') as the thread title, but the API returned 'Msg Recipient B'". Confirmed independently via curl against http://localhost:8001/api/conversations with two fresh signups.
bugs.workaround_in_checks: The browser check messaging-dm-and-team-chat locates B's thread by message body instead of by title to keep exercising real message delivery/isolation without being blocked by this bug.

checks.name: signup-session-persist-logout
checks.evidence: Signup lands on /dashboard/spaces (welcome card visible); full page reload keeps user signed in; sign-out returns to '/'; direct nav to /dashboard/my-day after logout redirects to '/' instead of rendering the shell.

checks.name: test_signup_session_persists_and_logout_clears_it
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/signup -> 200; GET /api/auth/me -> 200 (session persists); POST /api/auth/login with wrong password -> 401; POST /api/auth/logout -> 200; subsequent GET /api/auth/me -> 401.

checks.criterion: Space creation, switching and template-driven modules
checks.name: space-templates-and-switching
checks.evidence: Created student/professional/educator Spaces; student shows Courses/Flashcards/Quizzes tabs, professional shows Team/Projects, educator shows Students/Classes; switching back to student via sidebar updates header, search placeholder and tabs with no full reload.

checks.criterion: Space creation, switching and template-driven modules
checks.name: test_create_space_each_template_and_membership
checks.evidence: POST /api/spaces -> 200 for each of student/educator/professional/blank with correct template_id echoed back; GET /api/spaces lists all four; GET /api/spaces/{id}/members returns the creator as the sole 'owner'.

checks.criterion: Invite by email, accept, and membership visible to both users
checks.name: invite-email-accept-membership
checks.evidence: Owner invited a second account's email as editor; invite shown under Pending; invitee saw it in Inbox -> Invitations and accepted; Space appeared in invitee's sidebar; owner's Team list (after tab remount) showed both members with roles Owner and Editor.

checks.criterion: Invite by email, accept, and membership visible to both users
checks.name: test_invite_by_email_accept_and_both_see_membership / test_invite_declined_does_not_grant_membership
checks.evidence: POST /api/spaces/{id}/invitations -> 200 pending; GET /api/invitations (invitee) contains it; POST /api/invitations/{id}/accept -> 200; GET /api/spaces/{id}/members shows owner+editor roles. Decline case: POST .../decline -> 200, then GET /api/spaces/{id}/members for the decliner -> 404 (never joined).

checks.name: invite-by-code-join
checks.evidence: 'Create invite code' produced a code under Pending; a third account pasted it into the 'Have an invite code?' card on /dashboard/spaces and the Space appeared in their sidebar.

checks.name: test_invite_by_code_redeemed_by_third_account / test_redeem_invalid_code_rejected
checks.evidence: POST /api/spaces/{id}/invitations (email=null) -> 200 with a code; POST /api/invitations/redeem {code} as a third account -> 200; GET /api/spaces (that account) lists the Space with role='viewer'. Invalid code -> POST /api/invitations/redeem -> 404.

checks.criterion: Role enforcement (owner vs editor vs viewer)
checks.name: role-enforcement-ui
checks.evidence: Viewer's Team tab shows the 'cannot invite' notice and 0 invite-email inputs; editor's Team tab shows 0 role selectors and 0 remove buttons; owner sees role selectors and remove buttons; owner changed editor -> viewer and it persisted after a full page reload.

checks.criterion: Role enforcement (owner vs editor vs viewer)
checks.name: test_editor_and_viewer_cannot_manage_roles_or_delete_space
checks.evidence: Viewer POST invitations -> 403; editor POST invitations -> 200 (editor can invite); editor PATCH member role -> 403; editor DELETE member -> 403; editor DELETE space -> 403; owner PATCH role -> 200 and persists on re-GET; owner DELETE member -> 200.

checks.criterion: Messaging: DM and Space team chat, both send paths
checks.name: messaging-dm-and-team-chat
checks.evidence: DM sent via Enter and via the send button both appear immediately in sender's thread and reach the recipient's thread (matched by body, see bug note on title); Space team thread '<Space> — team' created and its message never leaked into the DM thread when switching conversations.

checks.criterion: Messaging: DM and Space team chat, both send paths
checks.name: test_dm_send_receive_and_thread_isolation
checks.evidence: See bugs[0]: recipient's GET /api/conversations shows title='Msg Recipient B' instead of 'Msg Sender A'. Message delivery and cross-thread isolation assertions in the same file passed; only the personalized-title assertion fails.

checks.criterion: Messaging: DM and Space team chat, both send paths
checks.name: test_space_team_thread_and_title
checks.evidence: POST /api/conversations (kind=space) -> 200, title contains the Space name; POST message to it -> 200.

checks.name: mentions-and-unread-badge
checks.evidence: @email mention message appears in recipient's Inbox -> Mentions tab and as a 'mentioned you' Activity row; sidebar Inbox badge shows a positive numeric count; thread row shows an unread badge that clears (count 0) after opening the thread.

checks.name: test_mention_and_unread_badge_clears_on_read
checks.evidence: POST message containing @email -> 200; GET /api/mentions (recipient) contains the message; GET /api/inbox/counts shows messages>=1, total>=1; POST /api/conversations/{id}/read -> 200; re-GET /api/conversations shows unread=0 for that thread.

checks.criterion: Cross-user data isolation and URL tampering
checks.name: cross-user-isolation-url-tamper
checks.evidence: Run against the ingress APP_URL. Non-member navigating to /dashboard/spaces/<id> was redirected to /dashboard/spaces and the Spaces page rendered (Space detail never rendered).

checks.criterion: Cross-user data isolation and URL tampering
checks.name: test_non_member_gets_404_from_members_and_cannot_act_on_space
checks.evidence: Outsider GET /api/spaces/{id}/members -> 404; outsider POST invitations -> 404; outsider DELETE space -> 404; the same GET as the actual owner -> 200 (sanity check).
